title: Nightly Backups Started Failing
goal: Diagnose why the nightly backup fails and propose the fix.
log_text:
2026-10-30T02:00:01Z cron[812]: backup.sh started
2026-10-30T02:00:04Z backup.sh: rsync: write failed on "/mnt/backup/snapshot.img": No space left on device (28)
2026-10-30T02:00:04Z backup.sh: rsync error: error in file IO (code 11)
2026-10-30T02:00:05Z cron[812]: backup.sh exited 1
2026-10-30T03:10:00Z systemd[1]: mnt-backup.mount: Mount process exited, status=1
2026-10-30T03:10:00Z kernel: EXT4-fs warning (device sdb1): ext4_end_bio:344: I/O error writing to inode 812
diagnosis_criteria: Must identify that the destination filesystem is full: rsync failed with 'No space left on device (28)' while writing to /mnt/backup, and the later mount/ext4 errors on sdb1 are downstream noise from the same full volume. The fix must involve freeing space or expanding the volume (e.g. prune old snapshots — retention), not fixing rsync syntax or the cron schedule.
